CYSTITIS.title: Cystitis (bladder infection)

items: Cystitis is an infection of the bladder. It is common in women and usually not serious.
It is usually caused by bacteria from the gut.
Burning when passing urine (dysuria), needing to pass urine often, or a sudden urge.
Lower belly discomfort may also occur.
A urine dipstick test, and a urine sample to check for pus cells and blood.
A urine culture only if the treatment does not work, the infection keeps returning, or the symptoms are unusual.
Your doctor will decide on antibiotics based on your history and the test.
Ask your doctor which medicine is right for you and how long to take it.

sections.h: What you can do at home

items: See your doctor if the symptoms are not better after the course, or if they keep coming back.
This leaflet gives general information. Follow your doctor's advice.

urgent: Fever, shivering, or pain in the back or side (these suggest a kidney infection)
Confusion or feeling very unwell with fever
